source.name: Gooey
source.originalDescription: When this Pokémon is hit by an attack, there is a chance it will spread slime around itself. The slime deals damage to Pokémon, Decreases their attack speed by 50% for 2s and applies a Gooey debuff. The Gooey debuff slows Pokémon by 10% for 6s and can stack up to 4 times per Pokémon. Gooey is a debuff that is applicable to Wild Pokémon and enemy players only. When this Pokémon enters tall grass, it continually recovers HP for up to 3s, until it leaves the tall grass, uses a move, or attacks. When this Pokémon recovers HP due to Gooey, its attack gauge is progressed towards a boosted attack. This HP recovery goes on a 10s cooldown after being triggered.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Gooey は 移動速度を下げる、HPを回復する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Hitting a Pokémon afflicted with a Gooey effect with a basic attack reduces all of this Pokémon's move cooldowns by 1.5s. Boosted attacks spew slime and if the slime hits Pokémon from a distance, a Gooey debuff is applied to those Pokémon and slows by 50% for 0.5s. If the boosted attack is used on a Pokémon in regular attack melee range, the attack deals increased damage.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 移動速度を下げる、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Bubble
source.originalDescription: Cover itself in a bubble, granting it a shield for 3s. When the shield’s effect duration ends or if this move is used again, the bubble shield pops, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and slowing them by 30% for 2s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Bubble は 移動速度を下げる、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
